mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and inhibit cardiac potassium channels; citalopram is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 which chlorpromazine inhibits, increasing citalopram levels; additive CNS depression and anticholinergic effects.
action: Avoid combination or use with caution; monitor ECG, QTc interval, and cardiac symptoms; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower cardiac risk; reduce citalopram dose if combination necessary.
